'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Bobby Hilburn LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bobby Hilburn]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
